title: 通胀利率压制科技，储能规划与周末公司事件仅作条件观察
summary: 11月13日A/H科技显著回调，美股半导体与硬件链同步承压；运行时美股指数期货反弹，但来源未展示独立报价时戳且代表股夜盘新成交不可得。储能行动方案、中美经贸沟通及源杰科技、新宙邦、TCL中环公告提供结构线索，均需开盘后价格验证；天孚通信因周五跌10.94%维持回避。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美国通胀与利率压力压低科技风险偏好
11月13日道指涨0.10%，标普500跌0.40%，纳指跌0.91%，费城半导体指数跌3.4%；美国10月PPI同比6.5%，美元升至19个月高位，2年期美债收益率创两年多最大周升幅。对A/H高估值科技的映射偏负面。 来源
国际
霍尔木兹紧张升级，海湾市场周末承压
油轮遇袭与导弹、无人机风险令周末海湾市场下跌，卡塔尔股指跌1.8%。能源供给风险支持油气链，但航空、航运成本与输入性通胀同时上升，不能单向解读为利好。 来源
国际
运行时美股期指反弹，尚不足以确认科技修复
本轮获取到道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别约涨0.26%、0.40%和0.80%。页面未展示独立报价时戳或延迟说明，且代表股尚无新的可核对夜盘成交，因此仅视为盘前风险偏好改善线索。 来源
政策
中美经贸代表继续就关税与农业议题沟通
商务部称双方11月13日举行视频会谈，就关税、“300亿对300亿”对等削减、农业等议题交换意见，并同意继续保持沟通。该进展有助于降低尾部风险，但尚不是具体行业订单。 来源
政策
新型储能行动方案提出2030年3亿千瓦目标
国家发改委、国家能源局提出到2030年新型储能装机规模达到3亿千瓦、平均储能时长约3小时，并支持锂离子、钠离子、液流电池和压缩空气等路线；文件同时要求有序建设、避免盲目扩张。 来源
市场
A/H周五收盘显示本地科技宽度明显转弱
上证、深证、创业板和科创50分别跌0.59%、2.05%、3.32%和2.30%；恒指跌1.55%、恒生科技跌3.02%。A股元件、通信设备和半导体资金与价格承压，今日公司级催化必须经过复牌或开盘后价格验证。 A股来源
科技
隔夜媒体领涨、硬件链领跌，A/H映射分化
Moomoo最新现金时段排行显示广播、广告代理居行业前两位，社交媒体、体育居概念前两位；半导体、通信设备、计算机硬件分别跌3.19%、4.25%和4.75%。媒体方向缺少直接公司催化，不强行给出个股；硬件链则继续要求本地价格止跌。 来源
公司
源杰科技获17.44亿元大功率激光芯片订单
公司披露与B客户签署17.44亿元（不含税）大功率激光芯片订单，合同自签字盖章起生效。订单规模构成业务催化，但量产、交付、收入确认与合同变更风险仍在，且周五股价已跌11.76%，公告后尚无交易价格。 公告
公司
新宙邦披露预计60万吨电解液供应安排
公司与亿纬锂能约定2026至2030年预计供应60万吨电解液，实际数量可在约定基础上调整，价格和数量以未来书面订单为准。长协支持产能消化，但原料、价格与履约节奏仍需验证。 公告
公司
TCL中环拟收购中环领先65.80%股份并复牌
TCL中环拟通过发行股份收购中环领先65.80%股份并募集配套资金，交易完成后强化半导体材料布局，股票11月16日复牌。审批、发行摊薄、估值与整合风险仍未消除，复牌价格是首要验证。 公告
公司
泉为科技退出三项光伏项目
公司董事会批准退出三项光伏项目并进行结算、退款，前期项目受土地、审批和融资等因素影响。该事件体现执行与资金约束，光伏政策或主题反弹不能覆盖公司层面风险。 公告
公司
天孚通信回购加码，但周五大跌仍是硬反证
公司11月13日回购40万股、成交5095.74万元，累计回购50万股并拟注销；但周五收盘124.99元、跌10.94%。新增回购不能把明显负面价格反馈包装成多头，短线维持回避。 公告文本

美股夜盘行情总结

宽基
指数期货
本轮运行时快照显示道指期货约+0.26%、标普500期货约+0.40%、纳指100期货约+0.80%。来源页面未显示独立报价时戳，故只用于方向性观察；与周五现金时段纳指-0.91%、标普-0.40%相比，情绪边际改善但尚未完成现金盘验证。
代表股
板块对照
行业与概念代表股在本轮未取得新的可核对夜盘成交；可见报价仍对应11月13日现金/收盘阶段，不能冒充当前夜盘。因此对15个代表股均不判定确认、背离或潜在反转，待美股延长时段出现真实成交后再分类。
映射
A/H映射
指数期货反弹对A/H风险偏好构成轻微缓冲，但周五美股半导体-3.19%、通信设备-4.25%、计算机硬件-4.75%，叠加A股创业板-3.32%、恒生科技-3.02%，硬件链仍需本地开盘止跌。媒体排行领先因无公司级催化不强行映射；储能和周末公告只列条件关注。

盘前结论

事实层面，周五A/H科技宽度显著转弱，美股半导体与硬件链同步下跌。高估值科技在美元、通胀与利率压力下仍处于风险收缩阶段。

运行时指数期货转涨，中美经贸沟通与储能行动方案提供边际支撑。但期指来源未展示独立报价时戳，代表股夜盘也尚无新成交，不能把盘前反弹写成全面确认。

源杰科技、新宙邦与TCL中环均有可核验公司事件，但公告后或复牌后价格未知。三者仅列条件关注；天孚通信因周五大跌维持回避。若开盘后不能守住前收并跑赢对应板块，条件关注失效。

重点个股关注

源杰科技
688498.SH
条件关注

事实与状态：17.44亿元大功率激光芯片订单构成明确业务催化；最近可靠行情为11月13日收盘673.10元、跌11.76%，发生在公告前，公告后价格尚未知。

确认条件：公告后首个有效交易时段守住前收，并持续跑赢半导体或通信设备板块；量产与交付计划无负面修订。

风险与失效条件：产能爬坡、客户验收、交付与收入确认可能延后；若高开回落并跌破前收，或订单被修改/终止，则取消关注。

新宙邦
300037.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：2026至2030年预计向亿纬锂能供应60万吨电解液；最近可靠行情为11月13日收盘51.69元、跌3.71%，尚无协议披露后的价格确认。

确认条件：开盘后站上前收并跑赢电池材料板块，后续书面订单显示数量、价格与回款安排可执行。

风险与失效条件：实际数量可调整，价格随订单确定，原料与扩产回报存在不确定性；若跌破前收且弱于板块，则取消关注。

TCL中环
002129.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：拟收购中环领先65.80%股份并募集配套资金；最近可靠行情为停牌前10月30日收盘9.38元、涨1.96%，时点陈旧且不含重组信息，今日复牌价格尚未知。

确认条件：复牌后价格守住前收并相对半导体材料板块走强，交易方案、估值与审批路径未出现实质恶化。

风险与失效条件：交易仍需审批，存在发行摊薄、估值、整合与方案调整风险；复牌跌破前收或放量走弱则取消关注。

天孚通信
300394.SZ
回避

事实与状态：11月13日新增回购40万股、累计50万股并拟注销；同日收盘124.99元、跌10.94%，明显负面价格反馈压过回购利好。

确认条件：仅在重新站上124.99元并连续跑赢通信设备/CPO同业，且成交与价格同步改善后重评。

风险与失效条件：AI硬件估值与行业宽度仍弱；若继续跌破周五低点或相对板块弱势扩大，回避结论强化。

板块轮动看板

受益方向储能行动方案支持多技术路线；源杰订单与TCL中环整合提供公司级线索，但均待价格确认。
观察方向中美经贸沟通、媒体与广告隔夜领涨；因缺少直接公司催化，不强行映射个股。
压力方向半导体、通信设备、计算机硬件及A/H高估值科技仍受利率与周五负宽度压制。
验证信号观察创业板、恒生科技能否止跌，以及三只条件关注标的能否守住前收并跑赢板块。

逻辑链

美国PPI与美元走高 → 美债利率压力上升 → 美股半导体和硬件链下跌 → A/H科技估值承压。
周五A股与恒生科技宽度转弱 → 周一盘前期指反弹只能提供缓冲 → 必须等待本地开盘价格确认。
储能2030年目标与公司订单 → 中期需求线索增强 → 但政策同时警示盲目扩张 → 只做条件关注。
广播、广告与社交媒体隔夜领涨 → 缺少直接A/H公司事件 → 记录为无候选，避免为凑数外推。

风险雷达

美国通胀、美元和短端利率继续上行，可能压低科技估值。
霍尔木兹紧张同时推高能源与运输成本，通胀冲击可能抵消油气链受益。
A/H周五科技宽度显著为负，盘前反弹不等于现金盘修复。
天孚通信周五大跌，是不能被回购公告覆盖的明确负面反证。
AKShare仅有11月11日旧盘中快照，本报不以其代表11月13日或今日宽度。

数据来源与时间点

首轮生成时间：2026-11-16 08:41 CST。美股现金时段排行：GitHub Actions/Moomoo，抓取于2026-11-14 09:27 CST，对应11月13日最新完整交易日；行业10行、概念5行。运行时期指：Futunn页面，本轮读取约道指+0.26%、标普500+0.40%、纳指100+0.80%，页面未展示独立报价时戳/延迟，代表股夜盘新成交不可得。A/H最近收盘：11月13日公开收盘数据；公司事件以深交所/CNInfo公告为主。国内发现源覆盖财联社与东方财富；已检查HKEX最新/业绩公告入口，未发现需要加入正文的恒生科技重大事件；金十当前A/H页本轮不可得，未作为证据。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-11 14:23:09 CST，仅作旧历史快照并显式降级。

Major News
Global
US inflation and rates pressure technology risk appetite
On Nov 13 the Dow gained 0.10%, the S&P 500 fell 0.40%, the Nasdaq lost 0.91% and the SOX dropped 3.4%. October PPI rose 6.5% year on year, the dollar reached a 19-month high and the two-year Treasury yield posted its largest weekly rise in more than two years. The A/H high-duration tech read-through is negative. Source
Global
Hormuz tensions rise as Gulf markets weaken
Tanker incidents and missile/drone risks pushed Gulf markets lower over the weekend, with Qatar down 1.8%. Supply risk supports energy, but airline, shipping and imported-inflation pressure prevent a one-way bullish reading. Source
Global
Runtime US futures rebound, but tech repair is unconfirmed
The runtime page showed Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures up about 0.26%, 0.40% and 0.80%. It displayed no independent quote timestamp or delay, while representative stocks had no new verifiable overnight trades, so this is only an improving pre-market risk signal. Source
Policy
China and the US continue talks on tariffs and agriculture
MOFCOM said representatives held a video call on Nov 13 and discussed tariffs, reciprocal “$30bn for $30bn” reductions and agriculture, agreeing to maintain communication. This lowers tail risk but is not a sector order. Source
Policy
New energy-storage plan targets 300 GW by 2030
NDRC and NEA target 300 GW of new energy storage with about three hours of average duration by 2030 and support lithium-ion, sodium-ion, flow-battery and compressed-air routes. The plan also calls for orderly construction and avoiding blind expansion. Source
Market
Friday A/H closes showed sharply weaker local tech breadth
The Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component, ChiNext and STAR 50 fell 0.59%, 2.05%, 3.32% and 2.30%; the Hang Seng and Hang Seng Tech lost 1.55% and 3.02%. Components, communication equipment and semiconductors were under pressure, so company catalysts require post-resumption or opening-price validation. A-share source
Tech
Media led while hardware lagged, producing a split A/H mapping
The latest cash-session ranking put broadcasting and advertising agencies atop industries and social media and sports atop concepts. Semiconductors, communication equipment and computer hardware fell 3.19%, 4.25% and 4.75%. No direct A/H company catalyst supports a forced media pick; hardware still needs a local price floor. Source
Company
Yuanjie Technology wins RMB1.744bn laser-chip order
The company disclosed a RMB1.744bn pre-tax order from Customer B for high-power laser chips, effective upon signing. The order is a business catalyst, but ramp, delivery, revenue-recognition and amendment risks remain; shares fell 11.76% Friday before the announcement, with no post-event price yet. Filing

Capchem discloses estimated 600,000-ton electrolyte arrangement
Capchem and EVE Energy expect 600,000 tons of electrolyte supply from 2026 through 2030, while actual volumes may vary and prices and quantities will follow written orders. The agreement supports utilization, but feedstock, pricing and execution need validation. Filing
Company
TCL Zhonghuan plans to buy 65.80% of Zhonghuan Advanced
TCL Zhonghuan plans a share-funded acquisition of 65.80% of Zhonghuan Advanced plus supporting financing, deepening its semiconductor-materials exposure; trading resumes Nov 16. Approval, dilution, valuation and integration risks remain, making the resumption price the first test. Filing
Company
Quanwei Technology exits three photovoltaic projects
The board approved exits from three photovoltaic projects and settlement/refunds after earlier land, approval and financing problems. The event highlights execution and funding constraints that sector policy or a theme bounce cannot erase. Filing
Company
TFC Optical adds buybacks, but Friday's plunge remains hard evidence
The company repurchased 400,000 shares for RMB50.96m on Nov 13, bringing cumulative purchases to 500,000 shares for cancellation. Yet the stock closed at RMB124.99, down 10.94%. The buyback cannot convert clear negative price feedback into a bullish case. Filing text

US Overnight Summary

Indexes
Index futures
The runtime snapshot showed Dow futures around +0.26%, S&P 500 futures +0.40% and Nasdaq 100 futures +0.80%. The page showed no independent quote timestamp, so this is directional only. Versus Friday's cash-session Nasdaq -0.91% and S&P 500 -0.40%, sentiment improved marginally but lacks cash-session validation.
Leaders
Sector checks
No fresh verifiable overnight trades were available for the industry and concept representative stocks; visible quotes still referred to Nov 13 cash/close stages and cannot be presented as current overnight prices. Confirmation, divergence and potential reversal are therefore all unclassified pending real extended-hours trades.
Mapping
A/H read-through
Higher index futures offer a modest A/H cushion, but Friday's semiconductors -3.19%, communication equipment -4.25% and computer hardware -4.75%, alongside ChiNext -3.32% and Hang Seng Tech -3.02%, mean hardware needs local price stabilization. Media leadership has no company catalyst and is not forced into a pick; storage and weekend filings are conditional only.

Pre-Market Takeaway

Friday A/H technology breadth weakened sharply while US semiconductors and hardware also fell. High-duration technology remains in a risk-reduction phase under dollar, inflation and rate pressure.

Runtime futures turned positive, while trade dialogue and the storage action plan provide marginal support. But the futures source showed no independent quote timestamp and representative stocks had no fresh overnight trades, so the rebound is not broad confirmation.

Yuanjie, Capchem and TCL Zhonghuan have verifiable company events, but no post-filing or post-resumption price. All three are conditional watches; TFC Optical remains an avoid after Friday's plunge.A failure to hold the previous close and outperform the relevant sector invalidates each watch.

Focus Stocks

Yuanjie Technology
688498.SH
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The RMB1.744bn high-power laser-chip order is a verifiable catalyst. The latest reliable quote is RMB673.10 at the Nov 13 close, down 11.76%, before the filing; the post-filing price is unknown.

Confirmation: Hold above the prior close in the first valid post-filing session and outperform semiconductor or communication equipment; no adverse revision to ramp and delivery plans.

Risks and invalidation: Ramp, acceptance, delivery and revenue recognition may slip. A gap-up reversal below the prior close, or an amended/terminated order, cancels the watch.

Capchem
300037.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The companies expect 600,000 tons of electrolyte supply from 2026 to 2030. The latest reliable quote is RMB51.69 at the Nov 13 close, down 3.71%, with no post-disclosure price confirmation.

Confirmation: Trade above the previous close and outperform battery materials, while subsequent written orders show executable volumes, pricing and payment terms.

Risks and invalidation: Volumes may vary, pricing is order-based and feedstock/expansion returns are uncertain. A drop below the prior close while lagging the sector cancels the watch.

TCL Zhonghuan
002129.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The company plans to buy 65.80% of Zhonghuan Advanced and raise supporting funds. The latest reliable quote is the stale, pre-event Oct 30 close of RMB9.38, up 1.96%; today's resumption price is unknown.

Confirmation: Hold the prior close after resumption and outperform semiconductor materials, with no material deterioration in valuation, approvals or deal structure.

Risks and invalidation: Approval, dilution, valuation, integration and amendment risks remain. A resumption break below the prior close or high-volume weakness cancels the watch.

TFC Optical Communication
300394.SZ
Avoid

Facts and status: The company bought another 400,000 shares on Nov 13, taking cumulative buybacks to 500,000 for cancellation. It closed at RMB124.99, down 10.94%, a clear negative price signal outweighing the buyback.

Reassessment condition: Reclaim RMB124.99, then consistently outperform communication equipment/CPO peers with improving price and turnover.

Risks and invalidation: AI-hardware valuation and breadth remain weak. A break below Friday's low or wider peer underperformance strengthens the avoid call.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesThe storage plan supports multiple technologies; Yuanjie and TCL Zhonghuan add company catalysts, but both await price confirmation.
WatchTrade dialogue plus US media and advertising leadership; no forced stock mapping without a direct company catalyst.
PressureSemiconductors, communication equipment, computer hardware and A/H high-duration tech remain under rate and breadth pressure.
ValidationWatch whether ChiNext and Hang Seng Tech stabilize and whether the three conditional names hold prior closes and beat their sectors.

Logic Chain

Higher US PPI and dollar → rising Treasury pressure → weaker US semis and hardware → A/H tech valuation pressure.
Weak Friday A-share and Hang Seng Tech breadth → Monday futures rebound is only a cushion → local opening prices must validate.
2030 storage target plus company orders → stronger medium-term demand signals → anti-overbuild warning → conditional watches only.
Broadcasting, advertising and social media lead → no direct A/H company event → no candidate, avoiding forced extrapolation.

Risk Radar

Further rises in US inflation, the dollar and front-end yields may compress technology multiples.
Hormuz tension raises both energy and transport costs, so inflation damage can offset oil-chain benefits.
Friday A/H tech breadth was sharply negative; a pre-market futures bounce is not a cash-session repair.
TFC Optical's Friday plunge is explicit negative evidence that a buyback filing cannot erase.
AKShare only has a Nov 11 intraday snapshot; this brief does not present it as Nov 13 or current breadth.
